  "phoneNote": "The warm photography and serif typography suit the shop, but the oversized opening-hours section interrupts browsing and pushes the products too far down.",
  "desktopNote": "The hero feels polished and shop-specific, but the enormous hours chart and unbalanced product row weaken the page’s rhythm.",

  "fixes": [
    "Replace the tall opening-hours bars with a compact timetable on both screens, bringing the product section substantially higher.",
    "Show the Koper location and street address beside the hero’s directions action rather than leaving the concrete location near the bottom.",
    "Use a distinct olive-oil product photograph instead of repeating the hero image, and arrange the desktop products in a balanced three-column row without the empty right-hand quarter."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop, hero and product section: the same olive-oil shelf photograph is repeated."
  ]
}
